replies.author: UnicornSniper
replies.body: If we are calling this 'Checkers' it should seriously be in a different color from the Checkmate one that some of us want to bring back into rotation, such as black and red, with flat terrain, and the only 'structures' would be the checker pieces which would make for some awesome game play depending on how high you want to make the pieces, but maybe break it towards the middle so that it takes a bit of planning and maneuvering to get to the two or three monuments that could be behind spawn, floating or still on the checker board, or also have a few checker pieces floating out to the side of the boards or back of boards (those are the pieces that were captured :P)
